component.name: Transom
component.summary: Native SSH, serial console and terminal workspace with integrated SFTP
原生 SSH、串口控制台与终端工作台，内置 SFTP

description.p: Transom is a desktop operations client: SSH and serial-console sessions, local shells and Telnet, with an SFTP file panel in one window. It renders through GPUI for a real GPU-backed terminal grid rather than an embedded web view, and every byte of the connection path is native Rust.
Transom 是一个桌面运维客户端：SSH 与串口会话、本地终端与 Telnet， 与 SFTP 文件面板共处一个窗口。界面经 GPUI 原生渲染，不内嵌浏览器； 连接路径上的每一个字节都由原生 Rust 处理。

ul.li: Nested split views, buffer search, semantic block view and OSC 133 / 777 notifications
Dual-pane SFTP with a transfer queue, resume, SHA-256 verification, remote editor and directory sync
Local, remote and SOCKS5 port forwarding, ProxyJump bastion chaining
Credentials stay in the OS keyring; catalog backup is plain JSON/YAML or an Argon2id-encrypted vault
